text:
You need a concise 5-page technical/grant proposal for an AI project, with diagrams and charts, written by someone who understands both AI and proposal structure.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python-based AI and ML work, and I can help shape a clear, technically grounded proposal that reads well for a grant audience. In a contract clause search assistant I built an assistant over 9,000 contracts that always quoted the clause and page it used, reaching 0.91 faithfulness and cutting clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. In a private wiki Q&A system, I built an on-premise assistant over 14k pages of engineering standards with zero external API calls and an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions.

I can turn your project goals into a polished technical narrative, system overview, and implementation plan.
